_note: v2 hooks for l'Avenue des Petits Travaux (ST_bricoleurs, S02_home), a tree-lined avenue opening into a high-summer country path with a wooden fence, the gadget-and-odd-jobs street (ST_routine seg015-019). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs; beret color = verb group.

fr_ruser_verb.hook: Sly Monsieur Verbe plays a crafty trick: he hides in a ROSE bush, with roses tucked in his beret (rew-ZAY).
fr_ruser_verb.why: ROSE → ruser = to use cunning, to trick (il a dû ruser pour entrer). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_conjuguer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ties two milk JUGS together with a blue ribbon: he CON-JUG-ates them (kohn-zhew-GAY).
fr_conjuguer_verb.why: JUG → conjuguer = to combine, to join together; also to conjugate a verb (conjuguer ses efforts). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (kohn-zhu-GAY -> kohn-zhew-GAY).

fr_adjoindre_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe ADD-JOINs himself to the fence crew, adding one more JOINed rail (ad-ZHWAN-dr).
fr_adjoindre_verb.why: ADD + JOIN → s'adjoindre = to take on, to join oneself to (s'adjoindre un assistant). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. GOLD beret = irregular (like joindre).

fr_bricoler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe LAYs BRICKs to build a little birdhouse: BRICK-o-LAY (bree-koh-LAY).
fr_bricoler_verb.why: BRICK + LAY → bricoler = to do DIY, to tinker (il bricole le week-end). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (bree-ko-LAY -> bree-koh-LAY).

fr_decortiquer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe shells peanuts to DECORate his TEA CAKE (day-kor-tee-KAY).
fr_decortiquer_verb.why: DECOR + TEA CAKE → décortiquer = to shell, to husk; to analyze in detail (décortiquer des crevettes). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_voiturer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe takes two smiling children for a sightseeing TOUR in his little open car (vwah-tew-RAY).
fr_voiturer_verb.why: VOITURE + TOUR → voiturer = to drive, to convey by car (il voiture les enfants). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (vwa-tu-RAY -> vwah-tew-RAY).

fr_culminer_verb.hook: At the very top of the hill, Monsieur Verbe cheers in his COOL sunglasses (kewl-mee-NAY).
fr_culminer_verb.why: COOL → culminer = to peak, to reach its highest point (la colline culmine à cent mètres). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (kul-mee-NAY -> kewl-mee-NAY).

fr_degainer_verb.hook: Quick as a flash Monsieur Verbe whips his paintbrush out of its belt pouch, and the startled pony goes 'NAY!' (day-gay-NAY).
fr_degainer_verb.why: NAY → dégainer = to draw (from a holster or pouch), to whip out (il dégaine son pinceau). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_gommer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe rubs out his drawing with a big pink eraser while blowing a bubble of GUM (goh-MAY).
fr_gommer_verb.why: GUM → gommer = to rub out, to erase (gommer une faute). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (go-MAY -> goh-MAY).

fr_alleger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe lightens his backpack by hauling out a giant LEDGER (a-lay-ZHAY).
fr_alleger_verb.why: LEDGER → alléger = to lighten, to make less heavy (alléger un sac). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_rider_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RIDES his little pedal boat and the pond RIPPLES behind him (ree-DAY).
fr_rider_verb.why: RIDE → rider = to wrinkle, to ripple (le vent ride l'eau). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_outrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe gasps 'OOH, my TRAY!': he is outraged at the breakfast tray tipped on the grass (oo-TRAY).
fr_outrer_verb.why: OOH TRAY → outrer = to outrage, to exaggerate (ce sans-gêne l'a outré). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_abstenir_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe refrains: he waves away the dripping jam doughnuts so there's no STAIN NEAR his shirt (ab-st'NEER).
fr_abstenir_verb.why: STAIN NEAR → s'abstenir = to refrain, to abstain (s'abstenir de voter). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. GOLD beret = irregular (like tenir).
ex: Abstenez-vous de parler pendant le film.
Please refrain from talking during the movie.

fr_doucher_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe showers under the watering can, singing 'DOO-be-doo!' (doo-SHAY).
fr_doucher_verb.why: DOO → se doucher = to take a shower (je me douche le matin). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_egrener_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pops the pods one by one into a bowl of GREEN peas (ay-gruh-NAY).
fr_egrener_verb.why: GREEN → égrener = to shell, to pick off one by one; to tell (beads), to tick off (égrener des petits pois). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_alarmer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe leaps in ALARM as the big alarm clock rings (a-lar-MAY).
fr_alarmer_verb.why: ALARM → alarmer = to alarm (ce bruit l'a alarmé). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_seller_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe heaves a red SADDLE onto the pony (say-LAY).
fr_seller_verb.why: SADDLE → seller = to saddle (seller un cheval). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_ecumer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe skims the soap FOAM piled as high as a CUMulus cloud (ay-kew-MAY).
fr_ecumer_verb.why: CUMULUS / FOAM → écumer = to skim; to foam; to scour (écumer le bouillon). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ay-ku-MAY -> ay-kew-MAY).

fr_assecher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe dries up the muddy puddle with a SACHET of sawdust (a-say-SHAY).
fr_assecher_verb.why: SACHET → assécher = to drain, to dry up (assécher un marais). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_renouer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe re-ties the snapped swing rope: as good as NEW (ruh-noo-AY).
fr_renouer_verb.why: NEW → renouer = to re-tie; to renew, to revive (renouer une amitié). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_friser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe brushes the white horse's mane into FRIZZY curls (free-ZAY).
fr_friser_verb.why: FRIZZY → friser = to curl (friser ses cheveux); to border on (friser le ridicule). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_sieger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sits in session on his hay-bale throne, with a blue JAY perched above him (syay-ZHAY).
fr_sieger_verb.why: JAY → siéger = to sit (on a committee), to be in session (le conseil siège ici). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_bonder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe carries a basket crammed full of BUNs (bohn-DAY).
fr_bonder_verb.why: BUN → bonder = to cram full, to pack (le train est bondé). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_rendormir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RAN to the hammock by the DOOR and, hand mirror on his chest, falls back to sleep (rahn-dor-MEER).
fr_rendormir_verb.why: RAN + DOOR → se rendormir = to go back to sleep (il s'est rendormi). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. GOLD beret = irregular (like dormir).

fr_adosser_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe leans his back against the oak for A DOZE (a-do-SAY).
fr_adosser_verb.why: A DOZE → s'adosser = to lean one's back against (s'adosser au mur). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_degourdir_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe stretches his stiff legs, and the young deer copies him: 'GOOD DAY, DEER!' (day-goor-DEER).
fr_degourdir_verb.why: GOOD DEER → se dégourdir = to stretch one's legs, to loosen up (se dégourdir les jambes). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. GREEN beret = regular -ir.

fr_apposer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe hangs A POSY on the garden gate (a-po-ZAY).
fr_apposer_verb.why: A POSY → apposer = to affix, to put up (apposer une affiche, apposer sa signature). RED beret = regular -er.
